messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: Bq7GnPJVqF81qNNgY7cyKg

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "Bq7GnPJVqF81qNNgY7cyKg"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

parsed.title: The Mirror Rescue of Ruined Amberhall

scenes.caption: The cartographer examines the ruined city from a hill.
scenes.visual_description: Mara the Cartographer stands on a grassy hill overlooking the collapsed towers and broken spires of Amberhall, her brass compass glowing faintly in the dusk light.

scenes.caption: The glass diver finds a way through a cracked window.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver presses his helmet against a shattered stained-glass window in the outer wall, the reflection of the city dancing on his coat.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a cursed tower ahead.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a dim alley, Oracle Lamp flickers and speaks, its single eye eyeing a looming black tower with a twisted spire.

scenes.caption: The tin fox scouts the castle gate path.
scenes.visual_description: Tin Fox scurries along a cobblestone street, its blue glass eyes scanning the massive iron gates ahead, key-wind tail ticking.

scenes.caption: Mara updates the map as the group gathers.
scenes.visual_description: Mara the Cartographer kneels over a spread map under a broken archway, inking a new route while the others arrive.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks a magic door.
scenes.visual_description: A heavy oak door with glowing runes stands ajar; the Sleeping Tax Collector lies across the threshold, snoring on a ledger pillow.

scenes.caption: The glass diver swims through the magic door's reflection.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver steps into a puddle of moonlight, his body turning liquid as he passes through the reflected door on the ground.

scenes.caption: Inside the tower, the oracle lamp reveals a hidden staircase.
scenes.visual_description: Oracle Lamp casts a beam of light on a spiral staircase hidden behind a tapestry of faded royal banners.

scenes.caption: The tin fox detects a trap in the stairwell.
scenes.visual_description: Tin Fox stops, one paw raised, blue eyes glowing as it hears a faint click from the stone steps ahead.

scenes.caption: Mara disarms the trap with her compass.
scenes.visual_description: Mara the Cartographer aligns her compass needle to a pressure plate, causing the floor to shift safely.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector wakes briefly and stamps a form.
scenes.visual_description: The Sleeping Tax Collector stirs, pulls a stamped paper from his sleeve, mumbles 'toll due,' then dozes off again.

scenes.caption: The group reaches the tower's top and finds a mirror vault.
scenes.visual_description: A circular room lined with mirrors reflects the group from all angles; in the center, a person is trapped inside a mirror cabinet.

scenes.caption: The glass diver enters the mirror to free the prisoner.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver presses his helmet against the largest mirror, his reflection stepping through into the silvered space beyond.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a collapsing floor.
scenes.visual_description: Oracle Lamp's flame flickers as cracks spread across the tower floor, dust raining from above.

scenes.caption: The glass diver emerges with the rescued person.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver steps out of the mirror, holding the hand of a dazed figure; the mirror shatters behind them.

scenes.caption: The group flees the tower as it crumbles.
scenes.visual_description: Mara, Tin Fox, and Oracle Lamp race down the staircase, the walls shaking and stones falling around them.

scenes.caption: They cross the old bridge to escape the city.
scenes.visual_description: A stone bridge spans a dry moat, old royal banners hanging tattered from its arch; the group runs across as the city gates collapse behind them.

scenes.caption: Mara closes her map as dawn breaks over the ruins.
scenes.visual_description: Mara the Cartographer rolls up her map on a hilltop, the ruined city glowing in the first light, her companions gathered around.
